changes.startup: Every launch opens the main Bot with the right sidebar collapsed; manually opened settings and their saved tab remain available.
changes.avatarTools: Main Bot can create and update committed avatar shape/color and report the actual saved appearance without replacing Bot identities or conversations.

companion.position: Centered in the right gutter between the composer and conversation content edge, lower edges aligned; follows first-message phase changes and settled window geometry.
companion.dragAndReset: Manual dragging suspends following; reset or next launch restores automatic placement.
companion.placement: Coalesced events and equal-bounds checks avoid redundant native placement; no new layout polling.

groupSettings.handoffDisplay: Per-group switch, enabled by default including old groups without the field; off hides historical and subsequent handoff/task cards while preserving chat, records and ongoing execution.
groupSettings.permissions: One selection applies sequentially to exact saved group executor Sessions with one shared risk confirmation and individual outcomes; private chats and other groups remain unchanged.
groupSettings.relayBudget: New groups default to sixteen total task starts per round; removed the production eight-task override. Existing saved group limits remain unchanged.
groupSettings.headings: Group, Bot and global settings category headings use font weight 600; ordinary field labels and hints keep their existing weight.

changes.attachments: File and folder chips, including restored semantic drafts, serialize as complete quoted file references. Group routing excludes file tokens before checking member mentions; original request and transcript text remain intact.
preserved: Katcats.AI naming, version and approved application/installer artwork
Main welcome illustration and tagline without the removed introduction paragraphs
Startup cover artwork, progress and status

checks: packaged product main Bot and primary create action are visible
main Bot welcome preserves the tagline without the introduction or duties paragraphs
fresh main Bot startup keeps the right sidebar collapsed
manual main Bot settings still open and expose its operation permissions
reload collapses a previously saved expanded sidebar without deleting its settings tab
original creation dialog saves two ordinary Bots in the Bot section
group creation saves a separate group sidebar entry and a clean group composer
new group creation defaults to sixteen total member task starts per round
group settings section headings are bold and handoff records are enabled by default
one safe bulk selection updates both exact group member permissions and reports two confirmed successes
bulk group permissions leave both members’ private chat permissions unchanged
group handoff display can be saved off, stays off when reopened and can be restored on without model calls

limitations: Installer was not executed or installed. Actual user data and installed application were not changed.
Product UI used the actual archived Host with a fresh synthetic profile and hidden isolated browser; no model messages or external model calls were sent.
Native companion positioning is covered by geometry, observer and IPC tests; a hardware compositor paint-count measurement was not performed.
Archive checks inspect prepared installer artwork inputs and approved assets; embedded NSIS bitmap resources were not separately extracted.
